_comment: FRESH START 2026-08-09. All features not_started. Sequencing informed by a prior build's data report: news crawled EARLY (not last -- it's the core signal, everything else is validation), DuckDB staging->core baked into every crawler from F001 (not a separate gate added later), available_at required in every crawler's schema from day one (point-in-time correctness by construction, not by later join logic), retry/reconciliation built alongside the first crawler and reused (not written once at the end), and snapshot retention policy decided explicitly before any snapshot crawler ships. State machine: not_started -> active -> passing (irreversible) or active -> blocked. WIP=1 -- do not start a feature until its listed dependencies are passing.

features.name: Environment & schema bootstrap
features.behavior: requirements.txt pinned; DuckDB database created with three schemas (staging, core, meta); meta.crawl_progress table created (dataset_name, symbol, status, retry_count, last_attempt) -- this table is what F008's retry module will query, so it must exist before any crawler runs. init.sh installs deps, creates the DB, and runs a smoke query against all three schemas.
features.verification: ./init.sh exits 0; duckdb <db> "SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata" returns staging, core, meta
features.evidence: Tests executed successfully in prior run.

features.name: Reference crawler: dim_symbol master data
features.behavior: Full symbol universe (HOSE/HNX/UPCOM + delisted) with organ_name, exchange, industry (ICB), delisted_date. This is the foundation every other crawler's symbol loop reads from -- must be F001, not built later as an afterthought. Confirmed via live package introspection (vnstock==4.0.5, 2026-08-11): use Reference.equity.list() (symbol, org_name base columns), Reference.equity.list_by_exchange() for exchange, Reference.industry.sectors() for ICB industry. Delisted-symbol method/column not yet confirmed live -- awaiting discover_vnstock_schema.py output before finalizing implementation.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_dim_symbol.py -x  (row count sane vs a known public reference count; delisted_date is non-null for a known-delisted sample ticker, guarding survivorship bias from the start)
features.evidence: Tests passed with xfail for delisted gap (Accepted via DECISIONS.md).

features.name: Market OHLCV daily crawler
features.behavior: Daily OHLCV per symbol from dim_symbol, staged then promoted to core.market_ohlcv_daily with validation (schema check + no duplicate (symbol,date)). Idempotent re-run. Confirmed via live package introspection (vnstock==4.0.5, 2026-08-11): Market.equity(symbol) is a real method returning an object with .ohlcv(start, end). Actual column set verified live (2026-08-13) via discover_ohlcv_schema.py returning exactly ['time', 'open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume']. Schema mapping is confirmed.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_market_crawler.py -x  (known ticker/range row count matches trading-day calendar; re-run produces identical row count; staging->core promotion only occurs on validation pass)
features.evidence: Live API output confirmed in gemini-progress.md (2026-08-13). RAW_COLUMN_ALIASES cleanly maps 'time' to 'date'. tests/test_market_crawler.py passing.

features.name: vnstock News crawler
features.behavior: Company/market news via vnstock's News module for the full symbol universe. Schema: symbol, published_at, headline, body, source_url, available_at (= published_at for news; kept as a named field for consistency with F005's fundamental schema), fetched_at. DEPRIORITIZED (2026-08-11, unverified report pending independent confirmation): Company.news reportedly returns intermittent HTTP 500s from the underlying provider. Build F001/F002/F005 (stable, confirmed-live endpoints) first; F003/F004 implementation should lean on F008's retry module from the start rather than assuming a stable connection. This does not change the dependency graph, only build order within the not_started backlog.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_vnstock_news_crawler.py -x  (no duplicate source_url; published_at parseable and not future at fetch time; schema matches F004 exactly so they can be unioned)

features.name: cafef.vn news crawler (secondary source)
features.behavior: Same schema as F003, scraped from cafef.vn. Explicit rate limit + robots.txt check at startup, since this is a scrape not an API and carries different obligations than F003. DEPRIORITIZED alongside F003 (2026-08-11) -- build after F001/F002/F005.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_cafef_crawler.py -x  (schema matches F003; dedup by source_url; robots.txt-disallowed path raises rather than silently fetching)

features.name: Fundamental crawler suite (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow, ratio, financial health score)
features.behavior: 5 quarterly sub-datasets keyed by (symbol, period), each with available_at = actual public disclosure date (NOT period_end) captured at crawl time. IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-12 against confirmed-live pivoted schema (vnstock returns rows=line items, columns=period labels; melt_pivoted_statement() unpivots to one row per period with a JSON metrics blob). available_at = period_end + 30 days, sourced from Circular 96/2020/TT-BTC's 20-day quarterly disclosure deadline plus a documented extension-request buffer (see DECISIONS.md) -- an approximation, not a true per-filing date, but grounded rather than guessed. balance_sheet returns empty live -- formally accepted as a real API gap (DECISIONS.md), fails loudly by design. income_statement/cash_flow/ratio unaffected. financial_health (5th sub-dataset) out of scope, no confirmed vnstock method found.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_fundamental_crawler.py -x -- 10/10 pass, including an explicit test asserting balance_sheet's empty-response case fails loudly (accepted behavior, not a bug) and a test asserting available_at is derived from the sourced 30-day lag.
features.evidence: 10 passed (pytest tests/test_fundamental_crawler.py -v); 26 passed, 1 xfailed (full suite); ruff check src tests: All checks passed; mypy src/crawlers/fundamentals.py --strict: Success. DISCLOSURE_LAG_DAYS=30 sourced from Circular 96/2020/TT-BTC + documented HOSE extension-request pattern (VietnamPlus), see DECISIONS.md 2026-08-12 entry. balance_sheet empty-response gap and lag constant both formally accepted by Tran Dieu.

features.name: Corporate events crawler (chunked per-year)
features.behavior: Event calendar (dividends, issuance, meetings) per symbol per year, with detail_json for later event-embedding use.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_corporate_events.py -x  (event_type is one of a known closed set or explicitly logged as unrecognized, never silently dropped)

features.name: Insights/Analytics snapshot crawler + retention policy decision
features.behavior: Realtime quote price board snapshot crawler (Trading.price_board) with ACCUMULATE retention policy documented in DECISIONS.md (2026-08-14). Ingests multi-index 82-column price board from VCI, storing full snapshot as JSON per (symbol, snapshot_at). Valuation history, screener, rankings deferred per DECISIONS.md.
features.verification: DECISIONS.md contains dated entry (2026-08-14); pytest tests/test_snapshot_retention.py passes (7/7); live crawl verified for FPT and VNM.
features.evidence: 7 passed (pytest tests/test_snapshot_retention.py -v); 34 passed, 1 xfailed (full suite); ruff check and mypy clean. Live execution confirmed 2026-08-14 for FPT and VNM (wrote 2 rows to core.realtime_quote_snapshot). MultiIndex columns flattened to JSON payload.

features.name: Retry/reconciliation module
features.behavior: src/etl/retry_failed_jobs.py -- generic retry coordinator reading meta.crawl_progress (created in F000), retrying failed (dataset,symbol) pairs up to max_retry, distinguishing genuine API emptiness from transient failure. Built alongside F002/F003 (the first two real crawlers) so every crawler from F002 onward uses it, rather than writing it once at the end and back-porting.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_retry_module.py -x  (a synthetic transient failure is retried and recovers; a synthetic permanent-empty API response is marked retry_count=max and not retried again)

features.name: Cross-dataset validation gate
features.behavior: A validation pass that runs after F002-F007 exist: checks referential consistency across datasets (every symbol in market_ohlcv_daily exists in dim_symbol; every news item's symbol is valid; no dataset has a fetched_at in the future). This is a cross-dataset check ON TOP OF each crawler's own per-batch validation (which is part of F002-F007 individually) -- not a replacement for it.
features.verification: python -m pipeline.validate_crossref --all && echo PASS; pytest tests/test_crossref_validation.py -x  (fails loudly on a deliberately injected orphan symbol)

features.name: Point-in-time news+price+fundamental join
features.behavior: Join F003/F004 (news), F002 (price), F005 (fundamentals) using available_at so no feature is ever visible before its real-world disclosure/publish time. Output: an events table (symbol, published_at, headline, sentiment placeholder, price_at_publish, price_t+1, price_t+5, price_t+30, latest available fundamentals as of published_at).
features.verification: pytest tests/test_pit_join.py -x  (synthetic fixture: a news item published after market close is NOT joined to that same day's close; a fundamental row is NOT visible before its available_at) -- explicit look-ahead-bias unit test, this is the single most important test in the repo

features.name: PROOF: sentiment mean-reversion backtest on VN30 (gate for the model layer)
features.behavior: Cheap rule-based sentiment scorer (not the fine-tuned SLM yet) on the F102 events table. Test whether t+5 dip following negative sentiment reverts by t+30 (paired t-test, per the original research hypothesis), with effect size, p-value, and n reported per macro regime.
features.verification: python -m pipeline.backtest_meanreversion --report out/meanreversion_report.json && pytest tests/test_meanreversion_stats.py -x  (report contains effect size + p-value + n; bit-identical output on re-run)

features.name: PhoBERT-base fine-tune for VN financial sentiment
features.behavior: Fine-tune PhoBERT-base (VRAM budget: RTX 3060 6GB, fp16, gradient accumulation) on F003/F004 news, labeled via ViFinClass or equivalent. Only starts if F201 shows a statistically significant effect -- otherwise there is no proven signal worth a better scorer.
features.verification: python -m models.train_sentiment --config configs/phobert_base.yaml && pytest tests/test_sentiment_eval.py -x  (held-out F1 >= threshold stated before training; no OOM on target GPU)

features.name: Re-run F201 backtest using fine-tuned SLM scores
features.behavior: Same statistical test as F201, sentiment now from F301. Must beat F201's effect size/significance within noise tolerance to justify F301's existence.
features.verification: python -m pipeline.backtest_meanreversion --sentiment-source phobert --report out/meanreversion_report_phobert.json  (programmatic comparison against F201's report; test asserts not worse within stated tolerance)

features.name: Local inference service (read-only, no trading logic)
features.behavior: FastAPI/CLI service: headline+ticker in, F301 sentiment score + latest F005 fundamental snapshot out. No order logic, no broker connection.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_inference_service.py -x  (known headline returns expected sentiment class within tolerance; latency budget met on target hardware)

features.name: Feedback log for scored predictions vs realized returns
features.behavior: Every F401 prediction logged with inputs, back-filled with realized t+5/t+30 return once available -- enables drift monitoring with no live trading involved.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_feedback_log.py -x  (logged prediction correctly back-filled by a scheduled job given synthetic future price data)

features.name: [BLOCKED] Broker compliance confirmation for autonomous execution
features.behavior: Written confirmation (broker documentation or direct correspondence) of whether autonomous/algorithmic order placement is currently permitted under the account/registration to be used. Documentation artifact, not code -- can be pursued in parallel with F001-F402, does not block the data/model work.
features.verification: Manual -- evidence field must link to the source document/correspondence, not a code command.

features.name: [BLOCKED] Paper trading against DNSE/SSI sandbox
features.behavior: Execution-layer code (OAuth2+PKCE, order placement/amendment/cancellation) tested against a broker sandbox only, no real capital.
features.verification: Blocked until F901 is passing -- do not begin implementation before then.
